turn.context: Why the Discharge Manager exists, explained before it is priced. No rupee figure in the drawing: the role is priced in part 4. The close hands over to the next part by name.

transcript.label: Transcript turn 26 · “Tell me more about why a Discharge Manager is needed”

text: Fair question. Here it is in one picture.
bullets: A discharge is not one job. It is a chain. Every step has someone. None of the gaps between them do.
So each step waits until somebody notices it. Whoever is free that day does the chasing.
That is why it hits your bed plan. Every time in the plan comes from a discharge time. With an owner, those become commitments.
chat.pointer: Pick a gap to see who waits there. Then switch to the chain with an owner.
chat.invite: The role costs about ₹4 to 4.5 lakhs a year. We set it against the revenue in part 4. Next is part 3, the key people. Shall we go there?
chat.note: Nothing is broken. The waiting is in the gaps.
